notes: IRPEF brackets: three-bracket structure per L. 199/2025 (Legge di Bilancio 2026); second bracket reduced from 35% to 33% effective 2026-01-01. Sterilization of detrazioni for redditi > 200,000 EUR (Art. 1 co. 3-4 L. 199/2025) is out of scope for this engine (see separate fiscal library).

work_deduction_breakpoints: Art. 13 co. 1 TUIR, as modified by D.Lgs. 216/2023 and confirmed by L. 207/2024 (Legge di Bilancio 2025). Breakpoints represent the piecewise-linear deduction schedule: flat at EUR 1,955 for income <= 8,500; linear from 1,955 to 700 in the 8,500-28,000 range; linear from 700 to 0 in the 28,000-50,000 range; zero above 50,000.

INPS rates: terziario sector (commercio ingrosso e dettaglio, CUAF intera). employer_tiers sourced from kitech.it 2026 (https://www.kitech.it/Contributi-previdenziali.aspx?p=4_138 for <=50; p=4_136 for 51-200; p=4_134 for >200). <=50 employees 28.98% (Table 7.1); >50 employees 29.58% — kitech.it shows identical rate for 51-200 and >200, so a single tier suffices. The +0.60pp employer delta (28.98% to 29.58%) reflects the switch from FIS (Fondo di Integrazione Salariale, applied for firms up to 50 employees) to CIGS ordinaria (Cassa Integrazione Guadagni Straordinaria, applied for firms above 50 employees); the CIGS employer share is 0.60% while the FIS employer share at that headcount is lower. Symmetrically, for >50 the employee rate rises from 9.19% to 9.49% (+0.30% CIGS employee share), see employee_tiers. SIMPLIFICATION: ivs_rate 23.81% at tier level is uniform across categories (no rate_by_category in terziario).

fixed_term_additional_rate: NASpI addizionale base rate 1.4% (employer-only) per Art. 2 co. 28 L. 92/2012, confirmed in force 2026 per INPS messaggi 269/2025 and 483/2025. The +0.50% increment per contract renewal is not modelled (SIMPLIFICATION).
INPS dipendente — employee_tiers: 9.19% up to 50 employees; 9.49% above 50 (0.30% CIGS employee share, consistent with the employer tier that adds CIGS above 50).

Apprentice contributions (L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773; L. 92/2012 art. 2 c. 36-37): employer 10% + NASpI 1.31% + 0.30% = 11.61%; employee 5.84%. Firms with at most 9 employees pay 1.5% (+1.61% NASpI) in months 0-11 and 3% (+1.61%) in months 12-23, then 11.61%. SIMPLIFICATION: hiring incentives (sgravi) and Cassa Edile apprentice schemes are not modelled.

IVS ceiling: massimale annuo della base contributiva 2026 = EUR 122,295.00 (INPS Circ. 6/2026, 30 Jan 2026, Art. 1 L. 335/1995 c. 18). Applies only when ivs_ceiling_applies=True (workers enrolled in INPS on or after 1 Jan 1996).
